events.label: Democratic candidates lead in 2026 midterm polling

slots.name: Democratic seats
slots.sentence: A recent Fox News poll found Democrats have a wider path to victory than Republicans in the House. Democrats are projected to win 215 seats compared to 201 for the GOP, meaning the left only needs three more victories out of the 19 possible toss-up races to clinch a majority.
